read: The Indian incumbent an entrant is actually pricing against: Rs64,468cr FY26 sales at a 23% operating margin, a margin band it has held between 23% and 25% every year since FY19 (Screener, HIGH). The 78.6% figure is share of a three-company listed base, not of the market, and it includes non-BPC revenue — the repo's own qualifier says so. What matters strategically is the shift in how HUL adds growth: sales have moved only Rs61,896cr to Rs64,468cr across FY24-FY26, and in the same window it bought Minimalist and Plum. A structurally low-growth incumbent with a 23% margin and an acquisition habit is the most likely eventual counterparty for a successful India entrant, and the most punishing competitor for an unsuccessful one.
